item.title: Chile's Valparaíso: where old songs find new voices
item.description: In Chile's storied port city of Valparaíso, a new generation is breathing life into boleros, waltzes and cueca, blending the city's musical traditions with sounds of today.

item.description: Political conspiracy films peaked in the 1970s. What do those films offer at a time when conspiracy theories flood social media and are repeated by the president and other politicians?

item.title: Gulf region on edge as Qatar leads talks with Iran to stave off new U.S. attacks
item.description: Qatar has been leading intense mediation efforts over the past 72 hours to prevent a new round of possible U.S. attacks on Iran after Tuesday's midterm elections. The uncertainty has the entire Gulf region on edge.

item.title: Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate in Michigan Senate race, spurning Abdul El-Sayed
item.description: Rep. Haley Stevens was scheduled to attend a unity event today with Abdul El-Sayed, who beat her in the Democratic primary. Instead, she endorsed his Republican opponent, Mike Rogers.

item.title: What a midterm race in Kentucky says about how Democrats may do in Trump strongholds
item.description: Democrats are putting up a fight in midterm races this year that went for President Donald Trump by double digits in 2024. Kentucky Public Radio's Sylvia Goodman explains what we can learn from one Kentucky district.

item.title: Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms
item.description: There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. GDP growth is up, but so are prices. For now at least, interest rates are staying the same. What does that mean for the midterm elections?
